an3.74:1.1: [vesālinidānaṃ] ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ānando vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
an3.74:1.2: atha kho abhayo ca licchavi paṇḍitakumāro ca licchavi yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho abhayo licchavi āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca :
an3.74:1.3: nigaṇṭho bhante, nātaputto sabbaññū sabbadassāvī aparisesaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paṭijānāti :
an3.74:1.4: carato ca me tiṭṭhato ca suttassa ca jāgarassa ca satataṃ samitaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paccupaṭṭhitanti.
an3.74:1.5: so purāṇānaṃ kammānaṃ tapasā vyantībhāvaṃ paññāpeti, navānaṃ kammānaṃ akaraṇā setughātaṃ.
an3.74:1.6: iti kammakkhayā dukkhakkhayo, dukkhakkhayā vedanākkhayo, vedanākkhayā sabbaṃ dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ bhavissati.
an3.74:2.1: tisso kho imā abhaya, nijjarāvisuddhiyo tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sammadakkhātā sattānaṃ visuddhiyā sokapariddavānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya.
an3.74:2.3: idha abhaya, bhikkhu sīlavā hoti …pe… samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
an3.74:2.4: so navañca kammaṃ na karoti. purāṇañca kammaṃ phussa phussa vyantīkaroti.
an3.74:2.5: sandiṭṭhikā nijjarā akālikā ehipassikā opanayikā paccattaṃ veditabbā viññūhīti.
an3.74:3.1: sa kho so abhaya, bhikkhu evaṃ sīlasampanno vivicceva kāmehi …pe… catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an3.74:3.2: so navañca kammaṃ na karoti, purāṇañca kammaṃ phussa phussa vyantī karoti.
an3.74:3.3: sandiṭṭhikā nijjarā akālikā ehipassikā opanayikā paccattaṃ veditabbā viññūhīti.
an3.74:4.1: so abhaya bhikkhu evaṃ sīlasampanno evaṃ samādhisampanno āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
an3.74:4.2: so navañca kammaṃ na karoti, purāṇañca kammaṃ phussa phussa vyantīkaroti.
an3.74:4.3: sandiṭṭhikā nijjarā akālikā ehipassikā opanayikā paccattaṃ veditabbā viññūhīti.
an3.74:4.4: imā kho abhaya, tisso nijjarā visuddhiyo tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sammadakkhātā sattānaṃ visuddhiyā sokapariddavānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāyāti.
an3.74:5.1: evaṃ vutte paṇḍitakumāro licchavi abhayaṃ licchaviṃ etadavoca :
an3.74:5.2: kiṃ pana tvaṃ samma abhaya, āyasmato ānandassa subhāsitaṃ subhāsitato nābbhanumodasīti.
an3.74:5.3: kyāhaṃ samma āyasmato ānandassa subhāsitaṃ subhāsitato nābbhanumodissāmi.
an3.74:5.4: muddhāpi tassa vipateyya yo āyasmato ānandassa subhāsitaṃ subhāsitato nābbhanumodeyyāti.
